FN-SL9KX87-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 307
Committee: Military and Veterans' Affairs Sponsor: Representative Rick Rehm
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 01/27/2026
House Bill 307 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department
of Workforce to establish and maintain a page on the department's website for the submission of
relevant documents and information, and a registry of private employers that implement a
voluntary veterans' preference employment policy under the provisions of this bill.
